example.title: Dirk and Cornelia J. Vander Wilt Cottage (NRHP)

brief: Dutch-immigrant 1.5-storey side-gabled brick cottage built right at the sidewalk: soft red brick with segmental brick arches over tall two-pane windows, iron wall anchors between the openings, a cream-painted boxed cornice and eave returns, and a steep wood-shingle roof with no dormers. Dark green four-panel door with a transom and small iron-railed steps; attic windows in the gable ends, limestone-edged flower beds along the wall.
